meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会直接向外部 API 发请求,网关自动带上已保存的凭证;不再要密钥或用浏览器登录。服务未连接时,返回连接链接供用户确认后重试。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取邮件、查看日历、访问 GitHub 等外部服务,或调用任何外部 API 时触发。

say.text: 读一下我 Gmail 里最新的 5 封邮件。
say.note: 会调用 Gmail API,网关自动注入凭证。

say.text: 看看我今天日历上有什么安排。
say.note: 返回日历 API 的结果。

say.text: 帮我列出我的 GitHub 仓库。

howto.what_en: Claude calls external APIs directly through the gateway, which injects stored credentials. No keys asked, no browser extensions. Unconnected services return a connect link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub, etc., or interact with any external API.

say_en.text: Read the latest 5 emails in my Gmail.
say_en.note: Calls Gmail API with credentials via gateway.
